package.name: dpcbf_viz_msgs
package.description: Visualization/diagnostics interface for the DPCBF control seam: the compact per-tick sample the control-side plot bridge publishes for the off-board plotting client (Computer 3). Carries ONLY data that exists nowhere else on the graph (nominal/safe command, barrier values, the obstacle set the QP actually consumed) — robot odometry and the perception obstacle stream stay on /odom and /obstacles_safe and are NOT duplicated here.
